contract: contract.json: persistent right utility dock; footer entry; current source remains interactive; exact-revision Handle & next; no advance on conflicts; stable selection; compact rows and fixed action area.

accessibility.evidence: Native Electron keyboard Tab reaches Refresh with computed outline >=2px; Escape in source input does not close the dock; Escape in dock returns focus to footer trigger. Arrow/Home/End row selection and no acknowledgment on navigation pass React tests. Native labels and high-contrast primary action inspected. No motion beyond existing color transitions; no animated scrolling.

responsive.evidence: Native fixture measured dock within viewport at 800x600 and 1440x900. Selected long title/error checked at 800x600: no document horizontal overflow and Handle & next remains within viewport. Actual running app opened the right dock and restored its previous Git utility panel on close; source terminal and its draft remained unchanged.

loading.evidence: Rendered React test retains the dock frame and Loading queue label until data arrives; trigger distinguishes loading and unavailable.

empty.evidence: Native first acknowledgment reaches empty pending state without closing the dock. Renderer last-item test confirms All caught up and no successor navigation.

error.evidence: Native Handle & next acknowledges current item then retains/selects successor when its source API is unavailable. Long-content screenshot shows the error within selected details; retry remains available. Receipt-conflict tests never advance.

partial.evidence: Native screenshots show one collapsed warning summary with current rows retained. Tests group 100 repeated warnings and omit unrelated sources.

success.evidence: Native source navigation moves focus to the source input while keeping queue mounted. Handle & next advances to the next pending item; tests prove receipt-before-open order and retain newer same-item revisions.

permission.reason: The dock does not grant permissions or add a consent flow. Existing PermissionRequest hooks render an Agent needs input row in the native fixture; failed source navigation is covered under error.

renderedEvidence.observation: Production Queue components in a sanitized native Electron workspace fixture. Footer entry, selected row, warning summary and fixed actions fit beside an interactive source.
Wide native fixture preserves source working area. Compact rows stay in the right dock and actions stay at its bottom.
Long title wraps in the selected detail area, truncates in the list, and source error does not push actions outside the narrow viewport.

limits: Native screenshots use the actual queue with an isolated backend and a lightweight source-input fixture, not the entire authenticated app.
Actual app placement and closing/restoring the Git panel were checked separately through native UI. No real queue items were acknowledged.
The running development main process still serves the earlier history projection; restart bun run dev to load the committed backend filter.
